description: Speech-to-text for a public MP3 or WAV file (audio_url, up to 30 minutes): transcript, detected language, timestamped segments and optional SRT/VTT subtitles (format=srt|vtt); task=translate returns English. Paid only, no free tier: $0.003 per started audio minute (minimum 1). Call without payment to get the exact quote for your file (x402 payment terms); then retry with params._meta["x402/payment"] or a prepaid credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...). Charged only when a transcript is returned. Not for m4a, ogg, flac or webm (convert to MP3 or WAV first).

audio_url.description: Public https URL of an MP3 or WAV file (up to 30 minutes / 30 MB).

format.description: json (default); srt or vtt also returns subtitles in the srt / vtt field

language.description: Optional ISO 639-1 code of the spoken language (e.g. en, es, de); detected when omitted

prompt.description: Optional context words or spellings (max 500 chars)

vad.description: Skip silence with voice activity detection (default false)

name: transcribe_audio
title: Transcribe audio (speech-to-text)
